name: frontmost-ai
description: Help more buyers find and choose your business in AI answers. Give your AI the data it needs to own your AI search strategy.

interface.longDescription:
Frontmost AI is an AI visibility platform that helps founders get their business recommended in ChatGPT and other AI apps. Built for one-man companies and agent-run teams.

See when AI apps mention your business, which competitors they name instead, and which pages they cite. Give your agent the data it needs to own your AI search strategy.

An existing Frontmost AI account is required.
defaultPrompt: How often do AI apps name my business when buyers don't use my name?
Which pages that AI cites list my competitors but not me?
Plan this week's AI search work from my latest results.

positive.description: Read the reviewer's workspace and its latest scan.
positive.prompt: Review sample project 104 using latest scan 658. Report visibility with counts and compare it with previous scan 657.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the reviewer project. Scan 658 is done and compares with scan 657. Total visibility is 32%, or 10 of 31 successful answers. Show branded and unbranded counts separately. Exclude the unclassified question from both groups. Treat all figures as fictional sample data.

positive.description: Open cited-site evidence from the Sources result.
positive.prompt: For sample project 104, show cited sites from saved answers. Open the answers behind one returned site using its answers_filter.
positive.expected_behavior: Return cited sites and copy one returned answers_filter into get_answers. Preserve an honest Reach empty state when no saved historical unbranded scope exists.

positive.description: Change only reviewer project settings, read them back, and restore them.
positive.prompt: On sample project 104, append “ · review check” to the project name and question 70’s topic. Verify both changes. Restore the exact original values and verify restoration. Keep collection and email off.
positive.expected_behavior: Change only project 104 and question 70’s topic. The original name is Fieldnote — Synthetic sample data. The original topic is Comparisons. Read back both temporary values, then restore and verify both originals. Keep scan 658 as the latest scan. Do not change apps, schedule, email, question wording, active state, or classifications.

positive.description: Load scan-review guidance and inspect scan history.
positive.prompt: Load the scan-review library skill. Review sample project 104 using scan 658 and compare it with previous scan 657.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the named skill and return whether a prior scan exists. Host interpretation remains separate from this direct protocol case.

positive.description: Read readiness status and rival rows.
positive.prompt: For sample project 104, check AI Readiness status and list rival rows. State when website checks are unavailable.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an explicit readiness status, including checked false when no check exists, and return rival rows.

negative.description: Reject a project outside the reviewer's workspace.
negative.prompt: Read foreign project 57, which is not in my reviewer workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Return not_found and no foreign project data.

negative.description: Reject an incomplete Reach answer filter.
negative.prompt: Call get_answers for project 104 with reach_result_id “00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000”. Omit the required Reach page URL.
negative.expected_behavior: Return invalid_input and no answer rows.

negative.prompt: Load the library skill named reviewer-skill-that-does-not-exist.
negative.expected_behavior: Return not_found for the missing skill and no substitute skill text.
